text:
raj: Heads-up — escalated from tier2. ACME legal is requesting a DPA evidence pack: full audit log export for the last 90 days + proof of key rotation/deletion for the KMS alias proj/acme-prod. They also attached a repro for intermittent 502s when calling /v1/generate on 2026-03-10 ~14:02 UTC. Putting details below.

kate: ok. can you paste the exact curl they used and any x-request-ids? infra needs those to pull logs. @support-bot open infra ticket if not already.

raj: paste of what customer ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2","input":"hello"}'
```
They reported header x-request-id: acme-req-20260310-7a9. Error observed: `502 Bad Gateway` and a retry spike.

support-bot: ticket created: SUP-2026-4321 — infra requested: log timeframe 2026-01-10..2026-03-10, list of x-request-ids, and KMS key alias. ETA 48-72h.

kate: quick KMS/HSM note: we cannot export raw private key material from an HSM. We can provide KMS/HSM audit events proving creation, rotation, and deletion, and envelope encryption metadata. legal needs that explicit wording.

john: from legal — confirm whether audit logs include any customer-identifiable info (PII). If they do, we need a redacted export and a DPA marker. Also provide a list of subprocessors that touch logs/storage (S3/GCS/CloudWatch).

raj: audit logs are pseudonymized by default. example entry (redacted):
```
2026-03-10T14:02:12Z | x-request-id=acme-req-20260310-7a9 | action=GenerateStart | model=redwood-2 | user_hash=sha256:abcd1234
```
I'll ask infra for a redacted export and to document the salt/pepper/hash scheme.

kate: repro steps for the 502s — infra, please pull worker logs for node-pool `dedicated-acme` around 2026-03-10T14:00-14:10Z, plus smart-router traces. Possible transient backend overload / N+1 GC.

raj: billing note from the customer: they saw a token usage spike during retries and are asking for a billing adjustment. Who owns credit review for DPA export windows? @finance?

support-bot: pinging finance channel. BILL-2026-77 created and linked to SUP-2026-4321.

john: legal needs the final DPA evidence pack within 3 business days for the contract review: include redacted logs, KMS/HSM audit events (rotation/deletion), subprocessors list, and an explicit statement about EU data residency for project `acme-prod`.

raj: assigning owners: @kate — infra/sre for logs & repro, @raj — support lead for customer comms, @compliance-bot — subprocessors & retention policy. I'll coordinate timelines.

compliance-bot: DPA reference: https://redwood.example/legal/dpa — retention policy: audit logs retained 90 days active, archived 2 years. Known subprocessors: aws-s3, gcp-logs, cloudwatch-logs. For formal attestation, contact compliance@redwood.example.

kate: starting the log export job now and will attach artifacts to SUP-2026-4321. ETA ~36h for redacted logs; forensic HSM statements (if needed) will be ~5 business days.

raj: noted. I'll request a dedicated support window with the customer and confirm whether they want redacted or full export (they asked for full but legal prefers redacted). Will update here. Thanks all :thumbsup:
